title: dbt Test Failures by Test Type
dataSources: dbt test results (`dbt:run_results`), warehouse metadata (`snowflake:query_history`, `bigquery:jobs`), and pipeline event logs.
app: dbt test results (`run_results.json`) and cross-platform freshness signals from warehouse INFORMATION_SCHEMA via DB Connect and HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dbt:run_results
| spath path=results{} output=results
| mvexpand results
| eval node=spath(results,"unique_id"), status=spath(results,"status")
| where match(node,"^test\.") AND status="fail"
| rex field=node "test\.[^.]+\.(?<test_type>not_null|unique|accepted_values|relationships|[a-z_]+)_"
| stats count as failures by test_type
| sort - failures
description: Parses dbt run_results to classify failing tests by generic type (not_null, unique, accepted_values, relationships) so teams see the dominant class of data-quality breakage.
value: Knowing whether failures are mostly uniqueness vs. referential-integrity problems guides systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.
implementation: Forward run_results.json; schedule after each dbt build and alert when failures for a test type spike.
visualization: Table of test type by failures, timechart, breakdown pie.
grandmaExplanation: We sort the failed data checks by what kind of rule they broke so recurring problems can be fixed at the root.
